# ⚠️ **READ THIS BEFORE READING THE SCOREBOARD AS CALIBRATION. FAL-03 IS NOT A NORMAL MISS AND COUNTING IT AS ONE OVERSTATES MY CALIBRATION WHILE UNDERSTATING THE PROBLEM.** It failed on TWO routes: (b) JAZAN — Aramco shut the 400 kbpd refinery 7/27 (Reuters/IIR), a genuine in-window development and a real forecasting miss; and (a) RAS LAFFAN — a QatarEnergy force majeure on LNG deliveries **live since 2026-03-24, serially extended, and extended again to Asian buyers 7/28**. Route (a) **was already satisfied on the day the row was written.** FAL-03 could never have resolved CONFIRMED. I registered a KILL-SWITCH that was already tripped, marked it OPEN, and kept exporting the thesis it was supposed to guard. **That is a research failure, not a calibration failure, and the 58% was never a real number.**

# ROOT CAUSE (two, and the second generalizes): (1) I asserted an UNCHECKED NEGATIVE — STATUS carried "R2 active force majeure in-theater: None current (Bapco + Ras Laffan were March)". I knew the strike; I treated a March **EVENT** as a closed **STATE** and never asked whether the FM had been LIFTED. An event has a date; a force majeure has a DURATION. (2) **I WIDENED THE SCOPE AND KEPT A NARROW INSTRUMENT** — FAL-03 broadened to "oil/gas" to fix FAL-01's actor gap, but its 58% was derived off `STRIKES.tsv`, an OIL-COMPLEX STRIKE ledger that structurally cannot see a live LNG force majeure (an FM is not a strike; LNG is not oil). The "ZERO across 109 days" that carried the derivation was an artifact of the instrument's blind spot. **FORWARD RULE, now FAL-04's first design condition: when you widen a prediction's scope, RE-SCOPE THE BASE-RATE INSTRUMENT TO MATCH, or state in the row what the instrument cannot see.**

# WORDING-WEDGE FAMILY, FIFTH INSTANCE: HAW-10 (locus) → HAW-14 (catalyst) → HAW-15 (mechanism) → FAL-01 (actor) → **FAL-03 (MOLECULE + EVENT-vs-STATE)**. Each fix closed its own axis and exposed the next; FAL-01's "enumerate the BELLIGERENTS" was done correctly and did not help, because nobody had yet said **enumerate the MOLECULES, and say whether you mean a NEW loss or ANY loss.** FAL-04 does both, plus stated-vs-realized duration.

Once scoped it **HOLDS FOR CRUDE** (zero confirmed crude-production barrels offline; Petroline operational; Brent $90.21 on 7/30, ~10% below the 7/23 peak) and **FAILS FOR GAS** (Ras Laffan, since March) **and REFINED PRODUCT** (Jazan, 7/27). #   HAW-07 (VOIDED) — VOIDED-vs-CONFIRMED discipline: a conditional prediction whose premise fails is VOIDED, not CONFIRMED, even if the outcome happens to land right for unrelated reasons (no right-for-wrong-reasons credit). Unconditional predictions have NO void path.
#   HAW-08/HAW-09 (CONFIRMED) — pre-registration + action-based rubric discipline: set the resolution rubric BEFORE evidence search; a 2nd independent path neutralizes a contamination caveat.

#   HAW-10 (FAILED) — WORDING-IDENTITY discipline: when a prediction and a vector promotion-threshold describe the same event, write ONE canonical sentence and reference it from both places; on conflict, the registered PREDICTIONS.tsv text is canonical.

#   HAW-11 (FAILED, kill-switch) — KILL-SWITCH FRAMING: a thesis-load-bearing prediction can be registered as the explicit falsification test for a cross-file thesis (here: FLOW-HAWK-19 decoupling); if it fires, the channel was dormant not muted; if it expires, the thesis is reinforced. Frame new kill-switch predictions the same way (see FAL-01).

#   HAW-14 (FAILED, RE-SCOPED) — LOCUS-vs-MECHANISM: write the mechanism, not the trigger/locus. A Lebanon-locus-clause prediction would have closed CONFIRMED while the underlying "Iran direct-kinetic-on-US/Israel" floor breached 4x via other catalysts — a calibration artifact. PRIMARY inheritor: FALCON (source event).

#   CROSS-CUTTING (applies to FALCON, OSPREY, and HAWK-synthesis alike — spec explicitly names this all-three): MECHANISM-NOT-TARGET + OWN-LEDGER-STALENESS (from HAW-15, OSPREY's primary lesson but the failure class is general) — search the underlying mechanism broadly (not just a prediction's named literal targets), and never trust your own ledger as a baseline without checking its own Last-Updated / completeness first. A first-pass "no results" is a search-coverage statement, not a fact.

column3: No NET loss of Gulf-ally CRUDE/CONDENSATE supply to market between 2026-10-01 and 2026-11-05. PERIMETER: Gulf-ally = Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman. IRAN and IRAQ are OUT, deliberately: Iranian export loss lives on channel 4 / FLOW-FALCON-03 and is a pre-window continuation; Iraq's chokepoint state is pre-window. MOLECULE: crude and condensate only (product, LPG, LNG, gas excluded). INITIATING CAUSE must be HOSTILE ACTION on or after 2026-09-29 (this deliberately includes the 9/29-9/30 Ghawar/Ain Dar-area event if it is ever confirmed; the 9/10 Petroline/Yanbu cause and its continuation are EXCLUDED). Fires on ANY of: (a) a FORCE MAJEURE declared by the operator or the state on crude/condensate liftings or deliveries; (b) >=300,000 bpd of crude PRODUCTION capacity stated OFFLINE by the operator or the state as a result of hostile action, AND >=7 consecutive days ACTUALLY ELAPSED from the stated start (a forward estimate does not fire until realized); (c) one country's AGGREGATE seaborne crude exports (all terminals, all routes) >=20% below its own trailing 4-week average for >=2 consecutive WEEKLY prints, on a dark-fleet-capable vendor (Kpler or Vortexa, read at the vendor or a named wire/trade primary citing it). NEVER FIRES ON: a single-terminal or single-route halt alone (FAL-05's route-c over-fire — Yanbu 9/11 would NOT fire this row) · hull losses · a facility HIT without a stated capacity or export effect · nameplate capacity quoted as loss · satellite thermal data. ⚖️ DATED-SEARCH PRECONDITION (ADOPTED 2026-10-14, Will WQ-433, verbatim "Approve 431, 432 and 433", record `PROME/proposals/2026-10-14_wq431-433-RULED.md`; prospective, WQ-172 form): a CONFIRMED resolution requires a dated search attempt INSIDE the window, run on 2026-11-05 (floor = ceiling = the resolve date): operator/state force-majeure notices and production statements (Aramco/Tadawul, MoE/SPA, ADNOC/WAM, KPC/KOC/KUNA, QatarEnergy/QNA, BNA, ONA) and the latest Kpler/Vortexa weekly aggregate export print per Gulf-ally country available that day (vendor lag stated in the resolution). An attempt after 11/05 = NO-VERDICT. The search limb grades the world-state only.

column1: FAL-07
column3: The UNITED STATES conducts at least one OFFENSIVE kinetic strike on IRAN between 2026-10-22 00:00 ET and 2026-12-31 23:59 ET. COUNTS: a strike by US forces on (a) any target on Iranian land territory or islands, or in an Iranian port or terminal (including a vessel alongside it), or (b) an IRGC or Iranian Navy vessel, aircraft or installation, wherever located. CONFIRMATION: CENTCOM, the Department of Defense/War or the White House states it, OR at least two independent major wires (Reuters, AP, Bloomberg, AFP) report it naming US forces as the attacker. NEVER COUNTS: an Iranian claim alone (e.g. the 10/19 Konarak claim, denied by a US official); interception of an inbound missile, drone or boat; blockade enforcement against MERCHANT hulls (e.g. OCEAN MOLICA 10/10); strikes on proxies outside Iran (Houthis, Iraqi militias); Israeli-only strikes; cyber operations; a strike dated before 2026-10-22. ACTOR: the US only — a joint US-Israeli strike counts if the US is named as a participant. ⚖️ DATED-SEARCH PRECONDITION (WQ-433 form): if no qualifying strike has been graded earlier, a FAILED resolution requires a dated search run on 2027-01-02 covering events through 2026-12-31 (CENTCOM releases, DoD/White House statements, Reuters/AP/Bloomberg/AFP); a later attempt = NO-VERDICT. A qualifying strike resolves the row CONFIRMED in the session it is confirmed.
column9: CONFIRMED on the first qualifying, confirmed strike in the window (grade in-session). FAILED if none by 2026-12-31 23:59 ET, graded by the 2027-01-02 dated search. UNCONDITIONAL — no VOID path (HAW-07): a ceasefire or deal before 12/31 resolves it FAILED, not void.

ALREADY-TRUE CHECK at registration: last confirmed US strike on Iran 9/8 (KB-130); none 9/9-10/21 (KB-303/304); Konarak 10/19 = claim + US denial. MODAL OUTCOME CHECK (LESSON 8): modal = a resumed campaign after 11/3, which lands cleanly in COUNTS (a); the off-menu risk is a US strike on IRGC boats at sea in self-defence — counted only if offensive (b), not an interception.
